name: baton
description: Persistent memory for long-running work: tasks, decisions and next steps survive between Claude Code sessions. Runs in Claude Code (terminal, IDE, the desktop app's Code tab); in a claude.ai chat the hooks do not load. Every task is a folder with a logbook, and four local hooks keep it that way: a session opens on the board of what is whose move, a turn that leaves this session's work unrecorded is handed back, a message that names a task brings up its record (and a long session is told to restart, from its transcript's token count), and an empty read result is flagged before it becomes "it is not there". The hooks make no network requests.

tasks_folder.title: Task folder
tasks_folder.description: Where your task folders live: one folder per task, each with its logbook. Created by you; Baton only reads it and names what it finds.

logbook.title: Logbook file name
logbook.description: The file in each task folder that holds its record, newest entry first. Use a word in your own language if you prefer.
